title: Synthesis, structures and magnetic characterizations of isostructural tetranuclear Ln4 clusters (Ln = Dy, Ho, and Eu)

material_class.structural_family: tetranuclear Ln4 cluster with mixed seven- and eight-coordinate Ln centers chelated/bridged by salen

synthesis.procedure: Dysprosium nitrate hydrate (88 mg, 0.20 mmol) in MeOH (10 mL) was mixed with H2salen (54 mg, 0.20 mmol) in MeCN (10 mL). NEt3 (0.14 mL, 1.0 mmol) was added, and the solution was heated at 70 °C for 2 h. The mixture was filtered, slowly evaporated in the dark, and dried in air.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: solution self-assembly with heating, filtration, and slow evaporation in the dark
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filtered, slowly evaporated in the dark, and dried in air

properties.summary: Tetranuclear Dy4 SMM with slow magnetic relaxation. Room-temperature χmT is field-dependent (51.22–56.11 cm3 K mol−1). At zero dc field, thermally activated relaxation gives τ0 = 2.4×10−6 s and Ueff/k = 17.2 K, with low-T quantum tunneling. At Hdc = 1.4 kG two relaxation modes appear (LT: τ0 = 5.5×10−10 s, ULT/k = 24.3 K; slower Debye fit τ0 = 3.2×10−6 s, Ueff/k = 23.3 K), attributed to dissimilar seven- and eight-coordinate Dy geometries.

measurements.name: Ueff/k
measurements.conditions: zero dc field; Arrhenius fit of ac relaxation; τ0 = 2.4×10−6 s; ac field 5 G

measurements.name: ULT/k
measurements.conditions: Hdc = 1.4 kG, low-temperature relaxation region; τ0 = 5.5×10−10 s

measurements.name: Ueff/k
measurements.conditions: Hdc = 1.4 kG, slower relaxation from χm''(f) Debye fits; τ0 = 3.2×10−6 s; T = 2–5 K

synthesis.procedure: Prepared by the identical procedure to 1, substituting Ho(NO3)3·5H2O for the Dy(III) salt: lanthanide nitrate (0.20 mmol scale of 1) in MeOH (10 mL) mixed with H2salen (54 mg, 0.20 mmol) in MeCN (10 mL), NEt3 (0.14 mL, 1.0 mmol) added, heated at 70 °C for 2 h, filtered, slowly evaporated in the dark, and dried in air.

reagents.amount: used in place of Dy(III) salt on the 0.20 mmol procedure of 1

synthesis.vessel_or_method: same solution self-assembly procedure as compound 1
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filtered, slowly evaporated in the dark, and dried in air (as for 1)

properties.summary: Isostructural Ho4 cluster. χmT at 300 K is 53.39–53.65 cm3 K mol−1 depending on field, close to four isolated Ho(III) ions, and decreases on cooling. AC susceptibility shows no appreciable frequency dependence or χ'' maxima at zero field or 1 kG; no slow magnetic relaxation.

source_locations.location: CCDC 870608 / NICXUU matched to Ho4 formula

material_class.structural_family: isostructural tetranuclear Ln4 cluster with mixed seven- and eight-coordinate Ln centers chelated/bridged by salen

synthesis.procedure: Obtained by the same procedure as 1, substituting Eu(NO3)3·5H2O for the Dy(III) salt: lanthanide nitrate (0.20 mmol scale of 1) in MeOH (10 mL) mixed with H2salen (54 mg, 0.20 mmol) in MeCN (10 mL), NEt3 (0.14 mL, 1.0 mmol) added, heated at 70 °C for 2 h, filtered, slowly evaporated in the dark, and dried in air.

reagents.name: europium nitrate pentahydrate
reagents.amount: used in place of Dy(III) salt on the 0.20 mmol procedure of 1

synthesis.vessel_or_method: same solution self-assembly procedure as compound 1
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filtered, slowly evaporated in the dark, and dried in air (as for 1); lattice water content supported by TGA (dehydration complete ~110 °C)

properties.summary: Isostructural Eu4 cluster. χmT at 300 K is 5.76 cm3 K mol−1 (1000 G) and decreases toward zero on cooling due to depopulation of 7FJ excited levels of Eu(III); Van Vleck fit gives λ = 302 cm−1. AC data show no slow magnetic relaxation at zero field or 1000 G.

measurements.name: spin-orbit coupling parameter λ
measurements.conditions: Van Vleck fit of χmT(T) for Eu(III)
